Workflow overview and setup

parameters.content:
## Plan and promote a balanced weekly menu

### How it works
Turn approved, available menu dishes into a balanced weekly specials reel. Enforce category variety, consider last week’s dishes, and prepare dated launch, midweek and weekend captions with tracked reservation links. A campaign log prevents duplicate completed campaigns and resumes saved jobs using the original snapshot. Review all media and copy before sharing manually.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys), Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`, and select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets nodes to one document: the menu plus Menu Campaigns. Add the exact headers in the [setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/restaurant-weekly-specials.md).
4. Supply DishKey, Dish, Category, Price, PhotoUrl, ThisWeek, InStock and Approval=approved. Set bookingUrl, timezone and campaign selection limits.
5. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns the plan, JSON and quote only; no editor draft or log writes.
6. Test manually, inspect the video and handoff, then enable the weekly schedule. Avoid overlapping runs; keep job IDs for recovery.

### Customization
Change campaignRevision only when deliberately replacing this week’s campaign.

nodes.name: 1. Set the weekly menu rules

parameters.content:
## 1. Set the weekly menu rules

Set timezone, minimum dishes, minimum categories, booking URL and campaign revision. Start with approved menu data and your own dish photos.

nodes.name: 2. Build a balanced menu from available dishes

parameters.content:
## 2. Build a balanced menu from available dishes

Read the menu and Menu Campaigns log. Exclude unavailable or partially available dishes. Select category variety, prioritize nominated dishes and rotate equal-priority dishes using last week’s history.

nodes.name: 3. Create the menu reel and three caption drafts

parameters.content:
## 3. Create the menu reel and three caption drafts

Saved jobs use their original campaign snapshot. New campaigns validate their design and credit ceiling. dryRun=true returns the full plan, design and quote without logging or rendering.

nodes.name: 4. Reserve the campaign and save its accepted job

parameters.content:
## 4. Reserve the campaign and save its accepted job

Save submitting before the paid request, then persist the accepted job ID. No paid submission retries. Run one execution at a time; a Sheets log is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 5. Wait for completion and record the outcome

parameters.content:
## 5. Wait for completion and record the outcome

Zvid polls the saved job within the deadline. Inspect failed or uncertain jobs before resetting state. Log headers: CampaignKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, VideoUrl, Caption, PlanJson, CompletedAt.

nodes.name: 6. Review the weekly promotion pack

parameters.content:
## 6. Review the weekly promotion pack

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Download the Monday, Wednesday and Friday caption plan. Review dates, menu availability and captions before scheduling; no social posts are published.
